jobs_results.description: Job Description: Task & accountabilities : Within Space Electronics, the PM will plan, initiate, lead and execute the Space Electronics Equipment projects developed in the Power Product line, through the application of project management processes, methods and tools to get the cost, quality and schedule targets. The PM’s main accountabilities and responsibilities are: Project Structuring / WBS Definition: Definition and set-up of the project Work Breakdown Structure, allowing for definition of consistent work-packages with inputs, outputs, tasks definition, resources allocation, Scheduling and milestones tracking Coordinate the tasks and activities of the Project Core Team Member as key interfaces of the departments supporting the project. Customer’s focal point and main interface. Responsible for the planning, identify , report and mitigate critical paths and tracking of internal/external milestones Risk and Opportunity Management to identify and set proper mitigation actions and... track active opportunities. Project Cost Control including Contract Change Management and periodic financial review consolidation following enterprise financial targets Project internal and external reporting by delivering standardized projects dashboards, including KPI’s and project trend charts Plan and organize project reviews, Phase Review and Maturity Gates Ensure and follow proper configuration management Support to Contractual data management Setting of the Project’s Development and Management plans to define the hardware model logic and strategy of the project to cope with customer’s requirements and successfully achieve the project’s milestones. Preparation of offers This role will involve some travel for business and as such you must be able to travel accordingly. Required skills : We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience: • Educated to degree level (or equivalent) in engineering or a related discipline. • Negotiation level communication skills in English and Spanish is required. • At least 3 – 5 years of experience in Project management. • PMI preferred •Active listening and leadership skills. • Rigorous, autonomous, customer-oriented mind-set and ability to prioritise workload. • Excellent interpersonal skills, including communication, multi-functional team-working, flexibility, proactive behaviour. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. jobs_results.title: Offshore Wind Project Manager - Foundations and Floaters
jobs_results.description:
Owing to continued growth and high demand for our services, we are looking for an Offshore Wind Project Manager, specialised in foundations and floating platforms design, to join our global energy team in one of our offices in Europe.
Whilst specialised in foundations and floating platforms design, as Project Manager you will also lead the delivery of offshore wind consultancy projects (owner’s engineering, due diligences and lender’s technical advisory, mainly) for clients worldwide and ensure they are delivered on time, on budget and with zero errors. This includes coordination of internal MM, and external resource where needed, deliverable review and acceptance, budget and time adherence, client liaison, and internal reporting on offshore wind projects. The role will also involve the preparation of bids for new work.
In summary, as an offshore wind professional within Mott MacDonald, ideally but not necessarily focused on foundation/platforms only, you will provide technical... support to a wide variety of stakeholders including developers, original equipment manufacturers, regulators and financing.

Candidate Specification :
Essential:
• Working knowledge of offshore structural engineering, including comprehension of the sea environment and hydrodynamic loads, both at temporary and operational stages.
• Deep understanding of the different foundation typologies for both bottom-fixed and floating, as well as the key drivers for the concept selection of each design solution.
• Awareness of the interfaces between turbine and foundation/platform, including key understanding of load iteration and integrated load analysis for offshore wind.
• Knowledge of the relevant Offshore Wind design codes and certification requirements, from DNV, IEC, ABS and other international standards.
• First-hand knowledge of offshore structural analysis software like SACS, SESAM, DEEPLINES or similar, to perform structural design and verifications.
• Familiarity with CAD or other modelling software
• Command on naval basic concepts (stability, masses, etc.)

Desirable:
• Demonstrable experience of project management of offshore wind projects or packages.
• Excellent IT skills particularly MS Excel/Word/Project and PowerPoint.
• Self-motivation, ability to use own initiative, flexible, problem solving approach.
• Experience of working within a multi-disciplinary engineering environment.
• Ability to communicate clearly & concisely in English, both verbally & written and ability to explain technical issues to non-engineers, including Clients.
• Ability to produce and review technical reports for clients, so attention to detail is paramount.
• Ability to lead/chair and present at meetings etc.

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

jobs_results.title: ME Project Leader (EPM)
jobs_results.description:
Key Responsibilities

1
Lead, plan and manage eMotor sub-system product development activities of development and customer application projects from the concept phase to series production readiness, according to the CAPM, Automotive SPICE and DES development processes.

2
Provide technical support in C0 phase programme opportunities.

3
Under the guidance of the Engineering Programme Manager (EPM) and the Application Engineering Manager, serve as eMotor sub-system technical interface to the customer

4
Manage, documentation and reporting, all the engineering deliverables according to the defined engineering scope. Ensure the generation of developed product specifications.

5
Coordination of requirements, capacities for the development and acceptance test to be carried out.

6
Coordination of prototypes and testing plans according to the development and customer application projects milestones.

7
Initiation and monitoring of cost reduction measures (VA/VE)

8
Regular review, reporting... / presentation of the development progress and its results as well as, if necessary, presentation of problem-solving analyses and their proposed solutions internally as well as to the customer.

9
Collaboration in the analysis of customer complaints and in the initiation of corrective measures to avoid future complaints and the resulting measures for product improvement

10
Escalate through the Head of Mechanical Project Manager any issues related to product and process alignment, meeting customer requirements, resources, and priorities conflicts within the eMotor development team etc.

11
Benchmark of competitor products

12
Development results analysis for patentability and support of patent applications.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
• Completed studies in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or electrical engineering or comparable degree
• Ideally 3 years of experience preferably in product development, project management or adjacent functions of eDrive systems. Experience in project organization of heterogenous teams
• Product knowledge and manufacturing process experience on electrical machine, ideally also in power electronics
• Knowledge within relevant development tools and processes like design, CAE, FMEA, testing DVP&R

Essential Competencies
• Communication and listening skills
• Confident appearance in front of the customer and presentations; preparation of presentation
• Collaboration and Negotiation skills
• Problem-Solving
• Tools
• Microsoft Office Standard Tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Microsoft Project / Planisware / Easy Redmine
• Basic CAD skills (CreoView)
• IQ-RM/APIS (FMEA Tool)
• Ideally PTC (Integrity Lifecycle Manager + Source) / Windchill RV&S

jobs_results.description:
Job Family: Project Management

Req ID: 409171

Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens. As a leader in transport solutions for more than 160 years, Siemens Mobility is constantly innovating its portfolio in its core areas of rolling stock, rail automation and electrification, turnkey systems, intelligent traffic systems as well as related services. With digitalization, Siemens Mobility is enabling mobility operators worldwide to make infrastructure intelligent, increase value sustainably over the entire lifecycle, enhance passenger experience and guarantee availability.

Mobility Management, Turnkey Projects & Electrification, Mainline Transport, Urban Transport and Customer Services. They have the know-how to make road traffic flow more smoothly and quickly, make trains more environmentally friendly and efficient, make train schedules and freight shipments more reliable. We work with our customers to develop optimal solutions to help overcome their... challenges.

Siemens Mobility Spain wants to get onboard the Overall Project Manager for a Rail Electrification and Signalling project located in Colombia, will be responsible for executing the project in compliance with the given requirements focus on critical international projects.

Area of Responsibilities

• Project organization and management

• Project controlling and project reporting

• Contract management incl. claim management

• Opportunity and risk management

Main Tasks

Support on Project organization and management

• Ensure that all plan elements (e.g. system structure, WBS, etc.) are taken into account in the sales / project initiation phase

• Handle all PM@Siemens-related plan elements and milestone results according to the project category

• Prepare and maintain the Siemens project management plan

• Plan the procurement strategy (in local Procurement entity) with the business manager and procurement department of the respective organizational units

• Ensure that all procurement activities comply with the applicable processes and regulations

• Monitor the performance of subcontractors / partners, escalate issues in good time (e.g. quality defects or problems in cooperation) and initiate appropriate measures in good time in the event of any non-conformities

• Manage regular project review meetings and organize the milestone prerequisites

• Manage the acceptance of supplies and services, subject to quality checks

• Document all work results in line with the applicable standards

Support on Project controlling and reporting

• Continuously monitor project status, in terms of cost, time and quality.

• Ensure the regular controlling of finances and regular reporting on finances

• Identify and minimize non-compliance costs

Support on Contract management incl. claim management

• With international (cross-border) projects: Synchronize the contract structure with the tax action plan and delegation concept

• Identify, drive, defend and reduce claims in good time

• Fulfill the contract and close the project in accordance with contractual and in-house regulations

• Define and agree the strategy to enforce / reduce / defend claims with stakeholders

• Involve the project team in the process of identifying changes and claims

Support on Opportunity and risk management

• Identify and assess all risk factors using the available risk assessment tools throughout the project

• Ensure that all risks are identified and monitored (including Compliance)

• Identify opportunities for further business with the partner(s)

• Ensure that all Opportunities are identified and monitored

• Identify / create additional opportunities from ongoing projects

• Ensure that risks&opportunities are monitored in all project phases

Experience & Knowledge required:

Master/Degree in Engineering

Know-how and experience in railway projects (Engineering, Project management, PMO…), preferably in International/multicultural teams.

Proven experience with Microsoft project / Microsoft project OnLine.

Technical knowledge of signaling railways systems: knowledge on Main Line and Mass Transit systems solutions and fundaments.

Knowledge of railway safety regulations: CENELEC 50126, CENELEC 50128 and CENELEC 50129.

Proven experience in interaction with customers/partners/providers.

Level of Spanish proficiency

Level of English B2-C1. With facility to have conversations and reading documents

Travel required

Soft Skills, Competences:

Ability and taste to solve problems.

Demonstrates professional judgement competence.

Result orientation

Team working

Good communication skill, organized speech.

Looking to improve the knowledge in the railway sector and professional development

Initiative and proactive.

If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit great minds from all walks of life. We recognise that building a diverse workforce is essential to the success of our business, therefore we encourage applications from a diverse talent pool. We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility requirements with our applicants to encourage agile working and innovation. Flexibility is our main benefit. We combine remote and presence work because work-life balance and wellbeing are essential for our teams. We are convinced that stay at home allow us to focus on activities that need more time for concentration and being at the office enhance our creativity collaborating and learning from others.

Siemens aboga por la igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres, así como en la Diversidad como fuente de creatividad e innovación. Contar con diferentes tipos de talento y de experiencias nos hace ser más competitivos y estar mejor preparados para responder con éxito a las demandas de la Sociedad. Por ello, valoramos a las candidatas y a los candidatos que reflejen la Diversidad que disfrutamos en nuestra Compañía y animamos la cobertura de puestos por mujeres y hombres en ocupaciones que se encuentren subrepresentadas.

#LI-ES1

jobs_results.title: Corporate Social Responsibility - Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Verisure is Europe's fastest-growing monitored security company and continues to strengthen its presence in South America. This rapid expansion and ongoing success is expected to continue. As a result, Verisure is reinforcing its new ESG team with an exciting, rewarding, and impactful position to support its ambitious growth plan.

Verisure is seeking a talented CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) Project Manager to join the team. This role provides an outstanding platform for a highly motivated individual to work with our Group ESG department, whilst providing strong visibility with key leaders in the company. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a transformational growth story. Critical and strategic, the role will be instrumental in advancing the company’s ESG agenda, shaping the CSR strategy and rolling it out at a global level. We are looking for someone who can make a tangible positive impact to transform and add value to our communities, not only to our Company but to... the industry itself.

The company’s success depends on its people and it invests in them every day. Working with Verisure is being part of an industry leading world-class company that has a strong entrepreneurial spirit.

Strategic context and Value proposition

Verisure has been actively pursuing increased focus and leadership on social and environmental issues to drive both business and societal value. This position will be part of a dedicated ESG core team, that will be delivering a new global CSR strategy and approach, designed to enhance business performance and shareholder value, energize employees, support our brand, and ultimately bring positive societal value and impact to Verisure communities and beyond.

The role will manage the development and implementation of our CSR strategy across Verisure different geographies. This role will strength of our ESG Roadmap through our new CSR strategy and its execution and roll out across different functions and in our markets. It will also oversee the establishment of data and content collection and validation processes for various stakeholder groups.

Responsibilities will include:
• Lead the development and execution of Verisure’s CSR strategy, CSR policy and it’s action plan
• Establishing data-driven CSR goals, milestones and metrics, and developing the analytical tools needed to evaluate and measure CSR efforts
• Leading the roll-out and building consensus for the action plan amongst key stakeholders in different countries within leadership teams.
• Developing and implementing a company-wide plan for collecting, storing, validating and distributing CSR data and content for reporting; adding value by responding to key stakeholders' requests
• Shaping CSR messages within the concept of strategy and long-term value creation for Verisure
• Lead on the development, planning and execution of CSR roadmap, including key actions and processes; (corporate volunteering, fundraising, donations, partnerships, thought leadership actions, etc.)

Reporting line and location

This role will report to our Head of Group DEIB. The position is a based in Pozuelo de Alarcón (Spain's HQ - Madrid).

Candidate profile

Experience and requirements

We are looking for a high potential, proactive and solution-oriented individual focused on driving value to the business who is looking for a challenging yet rewarding job. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn from Group HR, Group Finance, and other high-performing teams transversally
• 2 years of experience in designing, monitoring and managing CSR programs across different categories and relevant stakeholders, at a global scale. Experience in a strategy or management consulting role (pre-/post-MBA, depending on the overall experience) will be highly valued.
• Experience in interacting with key stakeholders internally and externally to obtain the buy-in for CSR objectives and initiatives
• Valuable experience in program/project management with evidence of working in a strategic and advisory capacity – strong consulting mindset and business partnering approach
• Experience in some of CSR main topics would also be required: Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB), community engagement and impact, employee well-being, social innovation, education initiatives, social/humanitarian crisis response
• Problem structuring, strategic problem-solving and very strong analytical skills, coupled with strong Excel skills
• Required: fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish. Other European languages are a plus.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills for Power Point slides creation and presentation
• Strong business sense, understanding the business impact of KPIs. Strategic and global thinking approach, coupled with effective management skills, including planning and decision making - proven track record of getting things done and leading projects to measurable impact
• Experience in managing dedicated and multiple projects with minimum guidance and in an autonomous manner
• Experience of working in international multi-cultural environments and with diverse remote teams
• Bachelor’s degree with some complementary education on social impact subjects

Competencies
• Strong sensitivity to corporate social responsibility topics, showing a commitment to ethical practices, sustainability and strategic contributions to the community
• Demonstrate a strong sensitivity to DEIB topics, fostering an inclusive and respectful environment that enhance different experiences and perspectives
• Good levels of emotional intelligence and a sound level of judgment - strong, confident yet humble leader that exerts influence through value-add leadership. Ability to interact at all levels, and manage interactions with the senior leadership
• Ability and willingness to take a "hands-on" approach, while maintaining an ability for a high level or strategic view of program activities
• Responsiveness, multi-tasking and balancing customer demands while managing multiple deliverables/deadlines. Ability to calmly respond to unexpected issues/priorities
• A match to our culture – high energy and flexible, and huge amounts of drive. Collaborative working is key

Verisure

We Are People Who Protect People

We are the leading provider of professionally monitored alarms for residential households and small businesses in Europe.

Peace of mind for families and small businesses

We believe it is a human right to feel safe and secure. We now protect more than 5 million families and small businesses. Our service includes 24/7 monitoring, expert verification and response, customer care, service and maintenance services, and professional technical support. As well as protecting against intrusion, we protect against fire, attack, theft, life-threatening emergencies and other hazards. Verisure people are dedicated and committed and provide what we believe is the best customer service in the industry.

Leading across a broad footprint

We are the leading provider of residential and small business monitored alarms in Europe. We operate in 17 countries across Europe and Latin America. Our business is driven by organic growth, based on our differentiated business model. We attract high quality customers. We work hard to ensure that our customers are happy. This contributes to an industry leading level of attrition and a long customer lifetime.

A technology-enabled human services company

Our 26,000 team-mates are the foundation of our company. Our business model combines technology and human expertise to protect people. We are a human services company. More than 80% of our colleagues interact with customers every day. This connection provides the insight that inspires our innovation. These insights are a source of advantage. We leverage these insights with the significant investment we make into product and service innovation. The close customer contact also fuels the pride which drives engagement.

35 years of experience – and many more to come

We have been protecting what matters most since 1988. Over that time, we have expanded beyond our roots in the Nordics and Spain. We now serve most of Europe and have also established a strong presence in Latin America. In 2017, to evolve our operating model, strategic innovation, operational excellence and access to talent, we opened our new Group headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. In 2019, we formed a strategic partnership with Arlo, a world leader in connected cameras. Verisure acquired all rights to Arlo’s European business. This allows us to offer connected camera services in Europe as a complement to our professionally monitored security service. It also allows us to access new go-to-market opportunities in retail and e-commerce.

Our winning DNA

Everything we do is driven by our DNA. Our DNA has enabled us to grow at a double-digit pace for many years and is setting us up to continue this journey.
• Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people have a sense of energy that is unmistakable, one that drives us to delight our customers and focus on creating impact quickly.
• Committed to Making a Difference: When we say we will do something; we deliver with excellence. We are accountable, focused and operate with discipline.
• Always Innovating: We believe that Innovation can be big or small; it’s a continuous state of mind that inspires us to think differently and always make things better. We are risk takers and we learn continuously.
• Winning as a Team: Our people know that by leveraging one another’s strengths, investing in and developing our team’s capability and by collaborating well, we will win.
• With Trust & Responsibility: Operating with integrity is core to our success. We are humble, honest and value deep mastery and expertise. We do the right thing, always

More than 80% of our colleagues interact with customers every day. This connection provides the insight that inspires our innovation. These insights are a source of advantage. We leverage these insights with the significant investment we make into product and service innovation. The close customer contact also fuels the pride which drives engagement.

35 years of experience – and many more to come

We have been protecting what matters most since 1988. Over that time, we have expanded beyond our roots in the Nordics and Spain. We now serve most of Europe and have also established a strong presence in Latin America. In 2017, to evolve our operating model, strategic innovation, operational excellence and access to talent, we opened our new Group headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. In 2019, we formed a strategic partnership with Arlo, a world leader in connected cameras. Verisure acquired all rights to Arlo’s European business. This allows us to offer connected camera services in Europe as a complement to our professionally monitored security service. It also allows us to access new go-to-market opportunities in retail and e-commerce.

Our winning DNA

Everything we do is driven by our DNA. Our DNA has enabled us to grow at a double-digit pace for many years and is setting us up to continue this journey.
• Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people have a sense of energy that is unmistakable, one that drives us to delight our customers and focus on creating impact quickly.

• Always Innovating: We believe that Innovation can be big or small; it’s a continuous state of mind that inspires us to think differently and always make things better. We are risk takers and we learn continuously.
• Winning as a Team: Our people know that by leveraging one another’s strengths, investing in and developing our team’s capability and by collaborating well, we will win.
• With Trust & Responsibility: Operating with integrity is core to our success. We are humble, honest and value deep mastery and expertise. We do the right thing, always

jobs_results.description:
BNP Paribas EMEA Finance employs 500 employees, of which more than 325 are based in Madrid. We manage more than 250 BNP Paribas entities from all over Europe, covering +60% of Group's balance sheet and all group's banking activities (Corporate & Investment Banking, Retail Banking, Personal Finance and other financial services activities…).
Our mission is to measure, control and explain all the financial indicators required to monitor accounting, tax, regulatory, liquidity, credit risk reporting and management result activities.
Data is a strategic asset for BNP Paribas, both to create value through and comply with stringent regulatory frameworks.
BNP Paribas focus is to maximize the value of data and gain competitive advantages across operational excellence, digital experience and innovation by
Improving decision-making processes, optimizing processes and industrializing use case with robust data, analytics and machine learning
Adopt new ways of working and new digital usage while... caring for user and employee data
Foster data enabled innovation to support -for instance- the sustainable transformation
Beside value creation, business and regulators increasingly ask for high quality standards, granular access, near real time availability, robust audit trails and advanced data infrastructures but also data protection and security practices are rapidly expanding and under scrutiny.
To meet this ambition Group Data Office's mission is articulated around four pillars:
Setting the Group data vision in alignment with the Businesses' strategies and objectives
Operationalizing this vision in close cooperation with IT and making data actionable to drive analytics and digital transformation
Capitalizing on the steering and animation of the Business Lines and Functions CDOs community to strengthen the data culture within the Group
Enforcing data governance policy including adherence to BCBS 239 and personal data privacy and protection regulations
MISSION:
Your field of intervention will cover all aspects of the data strategy, ranging from data management issues, ESG-data supply change to data privacy and protection, AI and smart automation and deployment of other technological tools or the study of new fields of action.
You will collaborate with Group Data Office experts, Business lines & Functions Data Offices and AI teams as well as other key partners across Marketing, IT, Legal, RISK, …

• Steer data projects, oversee development and deployment of solutions, from design and planning to implementation within budget and deadlines, while ensuring quality of the deliverables
• Ensure alignment of business needs and IT developments while incorporating by design all applicable data frameworks, guidelines & good practices

• Contribute to relevant Governance bodies and management presentations by drafting clear and concise material -including but not limited to-: project updates, decision-making support, working documents and meeting minutes

• Interest in new technologies and digital law
